aspect_ratio.description: The desired aspect ratio of the final image. Used over 'original_image_size' and 'original_image_location' if provided: the original is centred and the canvas grows around it.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

preserve_alpha.description: Keep the input's transparency. The model works in RGB, so the alpha channel is not generated -- the original's own is extended outwards by replicating its edges, which is what expanding a cutout means. Turn it off to get a flattened RGB result.
preserve_alpha.title: Preserve Alpha

original_image_size.description: The desired size of the original inside the canvas, as [width, height]; it is resized to this before being placed. Ignored if 'aspect_ratio' is provided.
original_image_size.title: Original Image Size

prompt.description: What should appear in the expanded area. Omit it and the model is asked only to extend the image, which is usually what you want for a plain canvas change.
prompt.title: Prompt

negative_prompt.description: Not supported by this model, and refused rather than ignored -- see 'prompt'. Present only so a request written against the SDXL expansion endpoint fails loudly here instead of silently losing the field.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

image_url.description: The image to expand (file or URL).
image_url.title: Image Url

original_image_location.description: Top-left corner of the original within the canvas, as [x, y]. May sit outside the canvas, in which case the original is cropped. Ignored if 'aspect_ratio' is provided.
original_image_location.title: Original Image Location

canvas_size.description: The desired size of the final image after the expansion, as [width, height]. Area must be under 25 megapixels. Pairs with 'original_image_location'.
canvas_size.title: Canvas Size

return_model_output.description: Also return the model's own frame, before the original was pasted back and the seam blended. Diagnostic only -- it does not change the returned image. Use it to tell a bad generation apart from a bad composite: a boundary already broken in that frame came from the model, not from post-processing.
return_model_output.title: Return Model Output

retain_original_quality.description: Keep the original's own pixels at full resolution. Generation happens near one megapixel, so a larger canvas is scaled up afterwards; leave this on and the region the mask protected is not resampled at all. Turn it off for a uniformly soft result, which can hide the seam on a textured background.
retain_original_quality.title: Retain Original Quality

seed.description: Reuse the seed from a previous response to recreate that result. Omit it for a random one, which is reported in the response either way.
seed.title: Seed

sync_mode.description: If true, returns the image directly in the response (increases latency).
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

model_output.description: The model's own frame at the requested canvas size, with nothing pasted or blended into it. Only present when 'return_model_output' was set.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

seed.description: The seed used, so the result can be reproduced.
seed.title: Seed

structured_instruction.description: The structured prompt the model conditioned on.
structured_instruction.title: Structured Instruction
